# Quest | Muscular Dystrophy Association

> > Quest is an adaptive lifestyle platform and digital community resource for people living with neuromuscular diseases, providing clinical information, personal stories, research updates, and advocacy support.

Quest serves the neuromuscular disease community through a comprehensive platform combining patient education, research news, lifestyle resources, and advocacy initiatives. The site features content from MDA experts and community members covering genetic testing, clinical trials, gene therapy, and daily living strategies for rare muscular dystrophies.

## Key Topics

- Muscular Dystrophy
- Neuromuscular Disease
- Gene Therapy
- Clinical Trials
- Genetic Testing
- Patient Stories
- Rare Disease
- RNA Therapies
- Accessibility
- Advocacy
- Patient Resources
- Research Updates
- Disability Inclusion
- Independence
- Muscular Dystrophy Association (MDA)
